article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Aaron Bradshaw scored 23 points to help Tennessee State cruise to a 123-73 victory over NAIA member Fisk on Monday night. Bradshaw added five blocks for the Tigers (2-1). Deondrea Lindsey scored 16 points and grabbed five rebounds, while Arterio Morris scored 15. Mitchel Seay led the Bulldogs with 16 points. Simeon Williams contributed 11 points, seven rebounds and two steals. Lucious Jackson had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
